audit_items.proof_trace: The `accrue_interest` function is `public(package)` (only callable within the package), so external callers cannot supply arbitrary `now` values. Every `public fun` entry point (deposit, withdraw, borrow, repay, liquidate, adl, emode, asset) derives `now` exclusively from `clock.timestamp_ms() / 1000`. Additionally, `borrow_index.set_value` asserts `self.last_updated <= now`, enforcing monotonicity and preventing time reversal.
